info.title: Mini Go E-Commerce API

get.description: Returns service status. Used by load balancers and health probes.

post.description: Authenticate and get JWT token pair

500.description: Internal Server Error - e.g. JWT generation failure

503.description: Service Unavailable - Redis is down, so logins are refused

post.description: Revoke a refresh token, ending its session: it can no longer be used to refresh. Access tokens already issued stay valid until they expire. Revoking a token that is already revoked succeeds too.

401.description: Unauthorized - not a valid refresh token

400.description: Bad Request - missing or invalid request body

500.description: Internal Server Error - e.g. the token store is unreachable

post.description: Get a new token pair using a refresh token. A refresh token can be used once: refreshing revokes it, so a replayed or revoked token is answered with 401.

401.description: Unauthorized - not a valid refresh token, or one already used or revoked

400.description: Bad Request - missing or invalid request body

500.description: Internal Server Error - e.g. JWT generation failure or the token store is unreachable

post.description: Register a new user account as a buyer

503.description: Service Unavailable - Redis is down; register shares the login rate limit, so it is refused too
